rv.q: Overall, David Copperfield is an imaginative piece of theatre that is truly well worth the watching but is even better if you brush up on your Dickens first.
Her direction is droll, very rarely buffoonish, and clips along with skill.
Guildford's Copperfield is dull as tarnished brass: the laughs are labored, the sparkle is incidental

cn.t: This three-person adaptation of Dickens' classic earns mostly positive notices for its ingenuity and infectious energy, though one critic finds it falls short of the company's previous work.
